title: senecio vulgaris var. crassifolius
intro: Senecio vulgaris var. crassifolius, commonly known as broad-leaved groundsel, is a variant of the Senecio vulgaris plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of broad-leaved groundsel include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Senecio vulgaris var. crassifolius include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
